doc:
**Pinsker's inequality** with the sharp constant.
`tvDistReal P Q ≤ sqrt(klDivReal P Q / 2)` for probability measures `P ≪ Q` with
finite KL divergence.
pretty:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] (P Q : MeasureTheory.Measure α)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure Q],
  P.AbsolutelyContinuous Q →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (MeasureTheory.llr P Q) P →
      MeasureTheory.tvDistReal P Q ≤ √(InformationTheory.klDivReal P Q / 2)
